title: Design System: Bola 8 Pool Club POS

body.purpose: Default UI text, ticket line items, form values.

label.purpose: Bold small state tags and meta text (e.g. DISPONIBLE, EN USO).

action.purpose: Button copy — always bold, sized to read as a target.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Modals and the login card only — signals a temporarily-elevated surface.

shadows.name: pulse-red
shadows.purpose: Looping pulse-border animation on in-use pool table cards (keyframes: 0 0 0 0 rgba(239,68,68,0.4) to 0 0 0 6px rgba(239,68,68,0)).

motion.name: transition-colors
motion.purpose: Default hover/active state transition on buttons and nav links.

motion.name: pulse-red-2s
motion.purpose: Urgency cue on in-use pool tables — a slow red border pulse.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0284c7; color: #f1f5f9; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; border: none; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0ea5e9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #38bdf8; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Confirm Button
components.description: Affirmative full-width action, e.g. Close Ticket / Pay.
components.css: .ds-btn-confirm { width: 100%; background: #16a34a; color: #f1f5f9; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; border: none; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-confirm:hover { background: #22c55e; } .ds-btn-confirm:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary/cancel action beside a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #cbd5e1; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #475569; font-weight: 600; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #334155; }

components.name: Resource Card — Available
components.description: Floor map table/resource card in its available state.
components.css: .ds-card-available { background: #1e293b; border: 2px solid #475569; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; min-width: 120px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-card-available:hover { border-color: #0ea5e9; } .ds-card-code { font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; color: #f1f5f9; } .ds-card-name { font-size: 12px; color: #94a3b8; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-status { color: #4ade80; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Resource Card — In Use
components.description: Floor map table/resource card while occupied — pulses red to signal urgency.
components.css: .ds-card-inuse { background: #450a0a; border: 2px solid #b91c1c; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; min-width: 120px; cursor: pointer; animation: ds-pulse-red 2s infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse-red { 0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(239,68,68,0.4); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(239,68,68,0); } } .ds-card-code { font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; color: #f1f5f9; } .ds-card-name { font-size: 12px; color: #94a3b8; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-status-inuse { color: #f87171; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text/password/number field with label, e.g. login username.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-label { font-size: 14px; color: #94a3b8; } .ds-input { background: #334155; border: 1px solid #475569; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; color: #f1f5f9; font-size: 16px; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #0ea5e9; }

components.name: Bottom Tab Bar Item
components.description: Mobile fixed bottom nav tab — emoji + label, active state turns Signal Blue, badge shows unread count.
components.css: .ds-tab { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex: 1; padding: 8px 0; gap: 2px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: #94a3b8; transition: color 150ms ease; } .ds-tab-active { color: #38bdf8; } .ds-tab-icon { font-size: 20px; } .ds-tab-badge { position: absolute; top: 4px; right: calc(50% - 18px); min-width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 0 4px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 9999px; background: #ef4444; color: white; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; }

narrative.overview:
Bola 8 is a room that stays dark, loud, and busy until close. The interface commits to that: near-black slate surfaces throughout, no light mode, no ambient decoration competing for attention. It reads like a late-night operations console — a floor map of glowing table states, queues that spike red when something's waiting, a login screen that's really a nameplate on a locked door.

Every visual decision serves one job: a waiter glancing at a table for half a second must know its state without reading a label. Color carries that weight, not typography or iconography — the type system is a single stack (system-ui) at a handful of weights, and icons are plain emoji dropped inline rather than a designed icon set. Nothing here is trying to look designed. It's trying to be readable from three feet away, one-handed, mid-rush.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only, no light theme — near-black bases (#020617–#0f172a) throughout
State is color-coded, not label-coded: green = available, red = occupied/urgent, amber/yellow = waiting or caution, sky = interactive/primary
Blunt, solid-fill components — no gradients, no subtle borders doing the work, generous tap targets
Flat by default; shadows appear only on floating surfaces (modals, the login card), never on inline cards
Emoji as the entire icon vocabulary — a project fact worth knowing, not a rule to defend

rules.name: The One State, One Color Rule
rules.body: A given semantic state (available, in-use, waiting, danger) always resolves to the same signal color everywhere it appears — floor cards, queue badges, buttons. Never introduce a second color for a state that already has one.

rules.name: The Floating-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows appear only on modals, dialogs, and the login card. An inline card that gets a drop shadow has been miscategorized as floating.

dos: Do resolve every state (available/in-use/waiting/danger) to its one reserved signal color, everywhere that state appears.
Do keep shadows exclusive to floating surfaces (modals, login card) — inline cards stay flat.
Do use bold, oversized action text on buttons; a Night Shift Console button is a target, not a sentence.
Do keep the type system to one family and a small weight set — hierarchy comes from size/weight/color, not a second typeface.
donts: Don't introduce a light theme or a light-background surface — the system is dark-only by design.
Don't add a drop shadow to an inline/resting card; that's reserved for modals and the login card only.
Don't repurpose a signal color (green/red/amber/emerald/violet) for a meaning it doesn't already carry elsewhere in the system.
Don't soften the high-contrast solid-fill button style into subtle/outlined-only variants for primary actions — floor speed depends on the fill being obvious at a glance.
